title: [AUG-194] Research: Settings → «AI assistants» tab — precise mockup, prefs, consent and status model (Option A)
why_we_need_this: AUG-193 agreed the direction (Option A: two independent toggles, consent only for the Claude session, Sonnet default), but the mockup there is a comparison sketch. Before implementation the user wants a precise, pixel-faithful design of the tab with every state, so the implementation task can be written as exact UI + preferences work without re-deciding anything. The tab is the foundation the Copilot and Active session tasks plug into (their toggles, consent and status live here). Source: @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md, @docs/mockups/AUG-193/ai-assistants-settings.html.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Precise HTML mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-194/ai-assistants-tab.html, self-contained, built on August's real Settings CSS (client/src/App.css .settings-* rules, 0 border-radius, terminal font): tab strip with «AI assistants» between Projects and Compact mode; rows Meeting Copilot, Active session (Claude), children Model (Sonnet default / Haiku / Opus), Spending limit per meeting (0.5–10 USD, default 2), Transcript window (2/5/10/15 min, default 5), Explain copilot hints with Claude; every state clickable: all off, copilot on, session on, consent modal, Claude Code not installed/not signed in (+ Recheck), PraxisOS not running, consent stale (version bump).
- [ ] Consent modal text finalized in plain language (what is sent, to whom, that billing goes to the user's own Claude plan via Claude Code login, no API key needed); reviewed against the Groq consent (AUG-164/190) for consistency.
- [ ] Preferences spec written: keys aiCopilotEnabled, aiSessionEnabled, aiConsent {acceptedAt, version}, aiModel, aiSessionBudgetUsd, aiTranscriptWindowMin, aiCopilotExplain — which are in ALLOWED_KEYS, sanitizers, defaults (all off), which are written only by POST /api/assistant/enable|disable; client UserPreferences additions; GET /api/assistant/status shape {claude: {found, version}, praxis: {reachable}}.
- [ ] Claude Code detection researched for Windows x64 and macOS arm64/x64: resolveClaudeCli() search order, `claude --version` check, how to tell «installed but not signed in» from «missing» (the user signs in through the browser, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), what the Settings row shows in each case; macOS PATH augmentation (electron ensureToolPaths) covered.
- [ ] Decision recorded in this card after the user reviews the mockup (AskUserQuestion); CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with SMART criteria and a link to the final mockup is created; its ID is written here and into the M4 roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no product code. Direction already decided in AUG-193 (Option A, Sonnet default); do not re-open Option B. Both toggles default off; the Copilot toggle needs no consent. Never show ports, paths or model internals in the UI. Cross-platform per @CLAUDE.md. Roadmap: M4 AI assistants.

Order: 1/3. Blocks: AUG-195-5dsqpc, AUG-196-gxk1pv. Parent research: AUG-193-bj5mw1.

## ⚠ Update from AUG-196 (decision of 2026-11-05) — the copilot row changes
- The «Meeting Copilot» toggle and the «Explain copilot hints with Claude» checkbox are replaced by a radio list of four modes: Off / Local hints / Claude explains (RECOMMENDED) / Always-on Claude (EXPENSIVE). Default Off. Each mode has a price and privacy line; see the Section B mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-196/copilot-hints.html.
- Choosing Claude explains is the consent itself; the copilot does not depend on the Active session toggle. Always-on is enabled only through the confirmation modal (with a checkbox) and has its own spending limit, `aiCopilotAlwaysBudgetUsd`.
- Keys: `aiCopilotMode`, `aiCopilotModel` (haiku|sonnet|opus, default sonnet), `aiCopilotAlwaysBudgetUsd`, plus `aiCopilotConsent` / `aiCopilotAlwaysAck`, written only through POST /api/assistant/copilot-mode. `aiCopilotEnabled` and `aiCopilotExplain` are dropped. Details: @docs/mockups/AUG-196/findings.md §2.
- Copilot implementation: AUG-197.

## ✅ Decision (2026-11-06, user reviewed the mockup)
- Mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-194/ai-assistants-tab.html — approved as final, with one change: both spending limits (`aiSessionBudgetUsd`, `aiCopilotAlwaysBudgetUsd`) are **free number fields** (real `.settings-input`, `$` prefix, any amount, committed on blur / Enter), **0 = no limit** (child spawned without `--max-budget-usd`). A dropdown of preset amounts was rejected: subscribers do not care about dollars per meeting and should just type a value.
- Settings card becomes **680 px** wide for all tabs (six tabs overflow 600 px with today's tab CSS). Rejected: tighter tab padding, renaming the tab.
- Claude copilot modes are **disabled but visible** while Claude Code is unusable (missing / not signed in / too old); a saved Claude mode stays selected with a warning and runs as Local hints.
- Final spec (layout, states, consent text, preferences, routes, Claude Code detection, Praxis /health probe): @docs/mockups/AUG-194/findings.md. Key findings: `claude auth status` returns JSON with `loggedIn` (0.35 s) — the sign-in check; `claude --version` 55 ms; Praxis `GET 127.0.0.1:7865/health` is tokenless; the child env must drop `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` so billing stays on the login.
- One Status section (Claude Code + PraxisOS + Recheck) on top instead of per-row hints.

**Implementation task: AUG-198-bc29es** (jarvis). Roadmap line M4 updated.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-06)
**Что сделано:** финальный кликабельный макет вкладки Settings → AI assistants на реальном CSS (@docs/mockups/AUG-194/ai-assistants-tab.html) со всеми состояниями: Status (Claude Code signed in / not signed in / not installed / too old / checking, PraxisOS), четыре режима копилота, Active session с детьми, обе модалки, stale-согласия, 680/600 px, узкая ширина. Спека @docs/mockups/AUG-194/findings.md: раскладка и правила состояний, текст согласия (по образцу Groq), таблица преференсов (5 ключей через PATCH + 5 server-only), 4 роута и форма статуса, детекция Claude Code, probe Praxis. Задача на реализацию AUG-198 создана, ID в карточке и в roadmap M4.
**Как:** sign-in проверяется через `claude auth status` (JSON `loggedIn`, 0.35 с), а не по файлам credentials (на macOS они в Keychain); `aiCopilotMode` и согласия пишутся только роутами assistant, чтобы Claude-режим не существовал без записи согласия; env дочернего процесса без ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — биллинг на логин, как обещает согласие. Отвергнуто: per-row подсказки с двумя Recheck, узкие табы / переименование вкладки (выбрана карточка 680 px), дропдаун пресетов лимита (выбрано свободное поле, 0 = без лимита), выбираемые Claude-режимы без Claude Code (выбрано disabled-but-visible).
**Файлы:** @docs/mockups/AUG-194/ai-assistants-tab.html, @docs/mockups/AUG-194/findings.md, @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md (D7 переписан, D9 probe, D11), @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
**PR / коммиты:** master, коммит «[AUG-194] Close …» (sha в git log); без PR.
**Грабли:** Sonnet-сабагент собрал макет с багом — re-render по клику разрушал чекбокс до события change, и модалка согласия не открывалась; исправлено (render только при действии). Chrome-расширение не открывает file:// — макеты смотреть через временный локальный сервер, гасить по PID. Пользователю нужны полные file:/// ссылки, а не @-пути.
**Хвосты:** JSON `claude auth status` в разлогиненном состоянии не снят (нужен scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) — критерий в AUG-198; Keychain из GUI-процесса на macOS не проверен (открытый вопрос AUG-193).
